name: Treasure
description: Treasure Format, named after the OCG's hand-disruption Spells, is a DM era format that predates the first banlist. The latest core set is Magic Ruler (MRL). Notable additions include the hand-disruption Spells, Mystical Space Typhoon, Painful Choice, recruiter Monsters, and Ritual Monsters. The hand-disruption Spells put a premium on going first and efficient deck-building.

defining_cards.name: Mystic Tomato
defining_cards.why: Losing it in battle could bring Sangan or another small DARK monster straight from the Deck, keeping a monster in play.

defining_cards.name: Delinquent Duo
defining_cards.why: For 1000 LP it stripped two cards from a full opposing hand, including one chosen at random.

defining_cards.name: Confiscation
defining_cards.why: For 1000 LP it revealed the opponent's hand and discarded a chosen card, breaking combinations before either piece reached the field.

defining_cards.name: The Forceful Sentry
defining_cards.why: Seeing the opponent's hand and shuffling one card into the Deck removed an immediate threat without stocking their Graveyard.

defining_cards.name: Mechanicalchaser
defining_cards.why: At 1850 ATK it beat the common 1800 ATK Normal Monsters by just 50 points without needing a tribute.
